scope: Private asynchronous disk-region read adapter; not live game integration or qualification

tooling.note: Full suite started before final reentrant-callback hardening. Both affected integrations rerun on final source below.

playtest.environment: Inherited assigned X11 display/authentication; synthetic CLI fixtures; no game profile
steps: Run deterministic blocked-worker lifecycle, cancellation and queue checks.
Open a production-encoded synthetic package through the real disk index/cache on the storage worker.
Compare four loaded cells and one known-absent result; reject invalid coordinate; retry; close and verify file cleanup.
Display actual CLI result; capture only this child window using xdotool PID selection and import with inherited DISPLAY.
playtest.expected: Pending/cancelled/failed reads never become empty data or partial lists; I/O stays on worker; cleanup completion reflects actual close.
playtest.observed: All assertions passed; 11 rejection cases; CLI exited 0; own-window screenshot inspected.
playtest.browser: Does not apply to tooling-only changes. No production/native harness source changed.

limitations: Private adapter only. Game world/root, renderer, physics, persistence and server integration remain unfinished.
Invalidation covers pending views of one immutable source; completed results still need owner-side world/root identity checks before publication.
Caller callbacks follow CompletableFuture rules; expensive callbacks must be dispatched away from the game owner.
Close and cancellation are cooperative. The close future must be observed; requesting close does not prove cleanup.
No new production admission limits, save formats or full-fixture runs.
No action/stall/frame/tick/memory/durability or city/maximum performance qualification claimed.
Physical GPU and shaped 32-client qualification remain pending. Stable rollout stays gated.
publication: New tooling/report/image pending controller publication and exact-source checks
